julia: Heads-up — nightly eval for q8_0-2026-03-19 flagged ~7.8% tool/function-call schema failures on prompt_set: guidance_search. Samples show 'args' field is a stringified JSON array instead of an actual array. Example:
```
{"tool": "kb_search", "args": "[\"refund policy\", \"en-US\"]"}
```
Failing observed only on quantized variants (q8_0, q4_0).

eval-bot: nightly-eval | 2026-03-19T03:10:00Z | model: q8_0-1.3 | failures: 78/1000 | regression vs fp16 baseline: +6.2% toolcall-schema

ben: Can you paste the raw assistant content for one failing case?

julia: paste raw content (truncated):
```
ASSISTANT: {"name":"kb_search","arguments":"[{\"q\":\"refund\",\"lang\":\"en\"}]"}
```

kai: Interesting — looks like the runtime is serializing the 'arguments' node as a string when the streaming / kv-cache path hits quantized kernels. Could be an accidental str() applied at streaming chunk boundary. Did the failure spike coincide with the kernel/streaming change last night? :eyes:

maria: Deploy logs show canary of runtime v2.14.3 at 02:45 UTC. That release included a small change in streaming chunk handling: `chunk = ''.join(parts)` — if parts contained bytes vs str that could coerce and surface as stringy repr.

ben: I ran a quick local repro against q8_0 on the quant runtime. The assistant outputs stringified args consistently when the prompt contains curly quotes or non-ascii punctuation. Suspect tokenizer/encoding interaction too.

julia: Quick mitigation plan: add a tolerant parser in the serving layer that attempts to json.loads any string-looking 'arguments' into array/object before passing to tools. If parse fails, fall back and log. I'll draft a hotfix for hosted & dedicated today.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-143-toolcall-stringified-args, severity: low, owner: @julia

kai: I'll open a test/PR against nightly-eval harness to assert that function/tool args are JSON-typed (not string). PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/1234 — adding edge cases with punctuation and streaming chunks.

maria: +1 on the hotfix. Also we should add a model-side guard in the generation postprocessor to ensure we emit native arrays/objects for function calls, not serialized strings. Will follow up with model-onboarding team.

ben: TL;DR: probable root cause = streaming concat change in v2.14.3 interacting with quant kernel path -> bytes/str coercion -> stringified JSON in 'arguments'. Mitigations: 1) add tolerant parse in serving layer (short term), 2) rollback or harden streaming concat, 3) add regression test to nightly-eval. :+1:
